definitions.gloss: to share, to divide among each other
definitions.explanation: To divide something and distribute it among multiple people so that everyone gets a portion. Implies mutual sharing.

examples.japanese: おやつを{分|わ}け{合|あ}った。
{喜|よろこ}びも{悲|かな}しみも{分|わ}け{合|あ}う{仲間|なかま}がいる。
examples.english: I have friends with whom I share both joy and sorrow.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}で{一|ひと}つのケーキを{分|わ}け{合|あ}って{食|た}べた。
examples.english: The family shared one cake and ate it together.

notes:
A compound verb from {分|わ}ける (to divide) + {合|あ}う (to do mutually). The {合|あ}う component adds the nuance of reciprocity — everyone participates in the sharing.

Can be used for both physical items and abstract things like feelings, experiences, or burdens.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{食|た}べ{物|もの}を{分|わ}け{合|あ}う (share food)
・{利益|りえき}を{分|わ}け{合|あ}う (share profits)
・{苦楽|くらく}を{分|わ}け{合|あ}う (share hardships and joys)
